75288-the-seven-dials-mystery.title: The Seven Dials Mystery
75288-the-seven-dials-mystery.creator: Unknown
75288-the-seven-dials-mystery.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The room was empty save for his hostess, and her reproachful gaze gave Jimmy the same feeling of discomfort he always experienced on catching the eye of a defunct codfish exposed on a fishmonger's slab. Yet, hang it all, why should the woman look at him like that? To come down at a punctual nine-thirty when staying in a country house simply wasn't done.

arxiv-2006-12393.title: A numerical study of gravity driven instability in strongly coupled dusty plasmas. Part I: Rayleigh-Taylor instability and Buoyancy-driven instability
arxiv-2006-12393.creator: Vikram S. Dharodi, Amita Das
arxiv-2006-12393.description: Abstract Rayleigh-Taylor and Buoyancy-driven instabilities are very common instabilities for an inhomogeneous medium. We examine here how these instabilities grow for incompressible viscoelastic fluids like a strongly coupled dusty plasma by using incompressible generalized hydrodynamic (i-GHD) fluid model. Since the dust particles are pretty massive, the gravitational attraction of earth has a significant role in its dynamics.

arxiv-2008-11053.title: JokeMeter at SemEval-2020 Task 7: Convolutional humor
arxiv-2008-11053.creator: Martin Docekal, Martin Fajcik, Josef Jon, Pavel Smrz
arxiv-2008-11053.description: Abstract This paper describes our system that was designed for Humor evaluation within the SemEval-2020 Task 7. The system is based on convolutional neural network architecture. We investigate the system on the official dataset, and we provide more insight to model itself to see how the learned inner features look.

arxiv-2103-04365.title: Thermodynamics of z = 4 z=4 Hořava-Lifshitz black holes
arxiv-2103-04365.creator: Mohammad Bagher Jahani Poshteh, Robert B. Mann
arxiv-2103-04365.description: Abstract Thermodynamics of z = 4 z=4 Hořava-Lifshitz black holes in 3+1 dimensions is studied in extended phase space. By using the scaling argument we find the Smarr relation and the first law for the black hole solutions of z = 4 z=4 Hořava-Lifshitz gravity.

arxiv-2107-03852.title: Augmented Data as an Auxiliary Plug-in Towards Categorization of Crowdsourced Heritage Data
arxiv-2107-03852.creator: Shashidhar Veerappa Kudari, Akshaykumar Gunari, Adarsh Jamadandi, Ramesh Ashok Tabib, Uma Mudenagudi
arxiv-2107-03852.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a strategy to mitigate the problem of inefficient clustering performance by introducing data augmentation as an auxiliary plug-in. Classical clustering techniques such as K-means, Gaussian mixture model and spectral clustering are central to many data-driven applications.

arxiv-2110-09902.title: Toward Understanding Convolutional Neural Networks from Volterra Convolution Perspective
arxiv-2110-09902.creator: Tenghui Li tenghui.lee@foxmail.com, Guoxu Zhou gx.zhou@gdut.edu.cn, Yuning Qiu yuning.qiu.gd@gmail.com, Qibin Zhao qibin.zhao@riken.jp
arxiv-2110-09902.description: Abstract We make an attempt to understanding convolutional neural network by exploring the relationship between (deep) convolutional neural networks and Volterra convolutions. We propose a novel approach to explain and study the overall characteristics of neural networks without being disturbed by the horribly complex architectures.

arxiv-2304-01907.title: Dynamical properties of volume at the spread in the Bitcoin/USD market Journal: Journal of Empirical Finance
arxiv-2304-01907.creator: Roberto Mota Navarro, Francois Leyvraz, Hernán Larralde
arxiv-2304-01907.description: Abstract The study of order volumes in financial markets has shown that these display several non-trivial statistical properties. Most studies have been focused on the bulk properties of volume of incoming orders or of realized transactions rather than the dynamical aspects. The present work is a study of the dynamical properties of volume.

arxiv-2304-08290.title: Backward martingale transport maps in pseudo-Euclidean spaces
arxiv-2304-08290.creator: Dmitry Kramkov, Mihai Sîrbu
arxiv-2304-08290.description: Abstract We consider an optimal transport problem with backward martingale constraint. The objective function is given by the scalar product of a pseudo-Euclidean space S S . We show that the supremum over maps equals the supremum over plans provided that the law ν \nu of the input random variable Y Y is atomless.

arxiv-2402-12465.title: Neuro-mimetic Task-free Unsupervised Online Learning with Continual Self-Organizing Maps
arxiv-2402-12465.creator: Hitesh Vaidya, Travis Desell, Ankur Mali, Alexander Ororbia
arxiv-2402-12465.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hitesh Vaidya, Travis Desell, Ankur Mali, Alexander Ororbia. An intelligent system capable of continual learning is one that can process and extract knowledge from potentially infinitely long streams of pattern vectors. The major challenge that makes crafting such a system difficult is known as catastrophic forgetting – an agent, such as one based on artificial neural networks (ANNs), struggles to retain previously acquired knowledge when learning from new samples.

arxiv-2405-13883.title: Gravitational Production of Heavy Particles during and after Inflation
arxiv-2405-13883.creator: Davide Racco, Sarunas Verner, and Wei Xue
arxiv-2405-13883.description: Abstract We investigate the gravitational production of a scalar field χ \chi with a mass exceeding the Hubble scale during inflation m χ ≳ H I m_{\chi}\gtrsim H_{I} , employing both analytical and numerical approaches. We demonstrate that the steepest descent method effectively captures the epochs and yields of gravitational production in a compact and simple analytical framework.

arxiv-2406-18405.title: Longitudinal chiral forces in photonic integrated waveguides to separate particles with realistically small chirality
arxiv-2406-18405.creator: Josep Martínez-Romeu, Iago Diez, Sebastian Golat, Francisco J. Rodríguez-Fortuño, Alejandro Martínez
arxiv-2406-18405.description: Abstract Chiral optical forces exhibit opposite signs for the two enantiomeric versions of a chiral molecule or particle. If large enough, these forces might be able to separate enantiomers all optically, which would find numerous applications in different fields, from pharmacology to chemistry.

arxiv-2507-13097.title: GraspGen: A Diffusion-based Framework for 6-DOF Grasping with On-Generator Training
arxiv-2507-13097.creator: Adithyavairavan Murali Balakumar Sundaralingam Yu-Wei Chao Wentao Yuan ∗ Jun Yamada ∗ Mark Carlson Fabio Ramos Stan Birchfield Dieter Fox ∗ Clemens Eppner ∗ * Work done at NVIDIA https://graspgen.github.io
arxiv-2507-13097.description: Abstract Grasping is a fundamental robot skill, yet despite significant research advancements, learning-based 6-DOF grasping approaches are still not turnkey and struggle to generalize across different embodiments and in-the-wild settings. We build upon the recent success on modeling the object-centric grasp generation process as an iterative diffusion process.

arxiv-2508-13267.title: A catalog to unite them all: REGALADE, a revised galaxy compilation for the advanced detector era Thanks: The full version of Table E.2 is only available in electronic form at the CDS via anonymous ftp to cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr (130.79.128.5) or via https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/cgi-bin/qcat?J/A+A/
arxiv-2508-13267.creator: Hugo Tranin, Nadejda Blagorodnova, Marco A. Gómez-Muñoz, Maxime Wavasseur, Paul J. Groot, Lloyd Landsberg, Fiorenzo Stoppa, Steven Bloemen, Paul M. Vreeswijk, Daniëlle L.A. Pieterse, Jan van Roestel, Simone Scaringi, Sara Faris
arxiv-2508-13267.description: Abstract Context. Many applications in transient science, gravitational wave follow-up, and galaxy population studies require all-sky galaxy catalogs with reliable distances, extents, and stellar masses. However, existing catalogs often lack completeness beyond ∼ 100 \sim 100 Mpc, suffer from stellar contamination, or do not provide homogeneous stellar mass estimates and size information. Aims.

arxiv-2508-15153.title: On the quantum 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 3 \mathfrak{sl}_{3} invariant of positive links Thanks: 2020 AMS Subject Classification: 57K16 (primary), 57K14, 57K10 Key words and phrases: positive knots and links, positive braids, fibered positive knots, state graph, quantum invariant, 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 3 \mathfrak{sl}_{3} invariant, w
arxiv-2508-15153.creator: Matthew Harper, Efstratia Kalfagianni
arxiv-2508-15153.description: Abstract . We use the skein theory of 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 3 \mathfrak{sl}_{3} -webs to study the properties of the quantum 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 3 \mathfrak{sl}_{3} -link polynomial of positive links. We give explicit formulae for the three leading terms of the polynomial on positive links in terms of diagrammatic quantities of their positive diagrams.

arxiv-2512-09618.title: Preprojective categories of type A A
arxiv-2512-09618.creator: J. D. Rock, H. Thomas
arxiv-2512-09618.description: Abstract . We introduce a continuous version of preprojective algebras of type A A . In particular, we are interested in the preprojective category over an open, bounded subinterval 𝕀 \mathbb{I} of ℝ \mathbb{R} , denoted Λ 𝕀 \Lambda_{\mathbb{I}} . We study the representable projective modules and define a useful type of sub- and quotient module called decorous modules.

arxiv-2601-04702.title: Chaos in high-dimensional dynamical systems with tunable non-reciprocity
arxiv-2601-04702.creator: Samantha J. Fournier, Pierfrancesco Urbani
arxiv-2601-04702.description: Abstract High-dimensional dynamical systems of interacting degrees of freedom are ubiquitous in the study of complex systems. When the directed interactions are totally uncorrelated, sufficiently strong and non-linear, many of these systems exhibit a chaotic attractor characterized by a positive maximal Lyapunov exponent (MLE).

Batalha, Anna Gagnebin, Tyler A. Gordon, James Kirk, Mercedes López-Morales, Sarah E. Moran, Jea Iyanla Redai, Nicholas Scarsdale, Johanna Teske, Ha
arxiv-2602-22327.description: Abstract We present the 3-5 μ \mu m transmission spectrum of HD 15337 c (TOI-402.02), a sub-Neptune (2.526 R ⊕ , 6.792 M ⊕ , T eq ∼ \sim 656 K) around a K1V star observed as part of the JWST COMPASS program. We reduce these observations with two pipelines and find consistent transmission spectra.

pmc-10594516.title: A Push to Consider Mantle Cell Lymphoma in Adults with Leukemia/Lymphoma with Blastoid Morphology
pmc-10594516.creator: Nkechi Arinze, Nivin Omar, Amany Keruakous, Ravindra Kolhe, Natasha Savage, Claudio Cerchione
pmc-10594516.description: Mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) is an intermediate-grade B-cell lymphoma, representing 2.8% of all non-Hodgkin lymphomas in the US. It is associated with t(11;14)(q13; q23), which leads to the overexpression of cyclin D1, consequently promoting cell proliferation. MCL usually expresses CD19, CD20, CD43, surface immunoglobulins, FMC7, BCL2, cyclin D1, CD5, and SOX11.

pmc-10595564.title: Sustainability and transferability of good practices for children's health promotion, obesity and NCDs prevention and responsive parenthood
pmc-10595564.creator: A Giusti, C Cattaneo, P Scardetta, V Palermo, F Zambri
pmc-10595564.description: A review has been conducted on the relevant results of previous European initiatives to capitalize on the outcomes of other Joint Actions addressing children's health promotion, responsive parenthood, obesity and Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs) prevention. The aim of this review is to gather knowledge, lessons learned, tools, and recommendations.

pmc-10612995.title: Illuminating Hope for Mental Health: A Drug Review on Lumateperone
pmc-10612995.creator: Martin Tarzian, Mariana Ndrio, Byron Chique, Japjit Serai, Bryce Thalackal, Jessi Lau, Adegbenro O Fakoya
pmc-10612995.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This drug review provides a comprehensive analysis of a novel antipsychotic called lumateperone, marketed as Caplyta. Lumateperone gained FDA approval in 2019 for treating schizophrenia and later, in 2021, for treating bipolar depression. The review begins by delving into lumateperone's mechanism of action, which involves the partial agonism of the dopamine D2 receptor as well as its unique effects on the dopamine transporter, N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor, and serotonin transporter. Additionally, the study examines lumateperone's distinctive pharmacokinetics.

pmc-10728661.title: Evaluation of the National Competence Based Catalogue of Learning Objectives (NKLM 2.0) for undergraduate medical education at the Medical School Hannover
pmc-10728661.creator: Marie Mikuteit, Ingo Just, Sandra Steffens
pmc-10728661.description: Background: The National Competence-Based Catalogue of Learning Objectives for Undergraduate Medical Education (NKLM) serves as the foundation for curricular development in undergraduate medical education in Germany. A new version of the NKLM was launched in 2021, and medical faculties are now evaluating the learning objectives (LOs). This paper describes the evaluation process used at Hannover Medical School.

pmc-11361911.title: Genomic profiling of colorectal cancer in large-scale Chinese patients: amplification and somatic mutations in ERBB2
pmc-11361911.creator: YUZHI LIU, EVELYNE BISCHOF, ZHIQIN CHEN, JIAHUAN ZHOU, BEI ZHANG, DING ZHANG, YONG GAO, MING QUAN
pmc-11361911.description: ObjectivesHuman epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-targeted therapies have demonstrated potential benefits for metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) patients with HER2 amplification, but are not satisfactory in cases of HER2 mutant CRCs.MethodsConsequently, further elucidation of amplifications and somatic mutations in erythroblastic oncogene B-2 (ERBB2) is imperative.

pmc-11396096.title: Impact of Ventilator Settings on Pulmonary Nodule Localization Accuracy in a Hybrid Operating Room: A Single-Center Study
pmc-11396096.creator: Jiun Yi Hsia, Hsu Chih Huang, Kwong-Kwok Au, Chih Yi Chen, Yu Hsiang Wang
pmc-11396096.description: Background: Pulmonary nodule localization in a hybrid operating room (OR) followed by thoracoscopic operation presents a viable alternative for early lung cancer treatment, potentially supplanting conventional two-stage preoperative computed tomography-guided localization. This hybrid OR technique enables lesion localization under positive ventilation, contrasting with the traditional method requiring concurrent respiratory motion.

pmc-12361332.title: The forced-response method: Urgency rediscovered
pmc-12361332.creator: Christian H. Poth, Anika Krause
pmc-12361332.description: Lee et al. (2025) presented their “forced-response method”, in which performance in a cognitive control task is assessed as a function of the time a target stimulus is visible (within a reaction time), in a situation with time pressure for responding. In the existing literature, this experimental approach has been referred to as the compelled-response paradigm or the urgent paradigm.

pmc-12532842.title: OnabotulinumtoxinA inhibits dysregulation of descending pain modulation following mild traumatic brain injury in mice
pmc-12532842.creator: Robson C Lillo Vizin, Caroline M Kopruszinski, Janice N Oyarzo, David W Dodick, Ron S Broide, Amy D Brideau-Andersen, Mitchell F Brin, Trent Anderson, Edita Navratilova, Frank Porreca
pmc-12532842.description: BackgroundDiminished conditioned pain modulation, a measure of endogenous analgesia, has been reported in patients with persistent post-traumatic headache (PTH), suggesting that inefficient endogenous analgesic mechanisms may contribute to the pain. Injections of onabotulinumtoxinA into the specific regions of the head and neck have shown some benefits in treating post-traumatic headache.

pmc-12650234.title: Molecular and Physiological Mechanisms Underlying Submerged Germination in Rice
pmc-12650234.creator: Shuang Jia, Qianya Zhou, Shengqi Yuan, Yifeng Wang, Zhongchen Zhang
pmc-12650234.description: Simple SummarySeed dormancy and germination are crucial traits that enable rice to adapt to adverse conditions and maintain its reproductive capacity. Flood (submergence) is a major abiotic stress that inhibits rice seed germination, reducing submerged germination efficiency and seedling uniformity.

pmc-12709811.title: Postural control in top-level Para Karate athletes with visual and intellectual impairment: an observational study
pmc-12709811.creator: Henrieta Horníková, Radovan Hadža, Michal Hrubý, Dušana Augustovičová
pmc-12709811.description: BackgroundAlthough the World Karate Federation (WKF) lacks a standardized test battery, Para Karate classification follows International Paralympic Committee (IPC) principles, with balance recognized as a key physical ability affecting kata performance. This study aimed to compare postural stability across categories and classes of top-level Para Karate athletes and to provide evidence supporting classification refinement.

pmc-13062328.title: Sacral Insufficiency Fracture Following L4–S1 Circumferential Fusion in Corticosteroid-associated Bone Fragility: A Case Report and Biomechanical Considerations
pmc-13062328.creator: Ratko Yurac Barrientos, Joaquín Zúñiga Soria, Andrea Marré Chadwick, Nicolás Bifani Toche
pmc-13062328.description: Introduction:Sacral insufficiency fracture (SIF) is an uncommon but increasingly recognized complication following lumbosacral fusion, particularly in patients with compromised bone quality. The biomechanical vulnerability of the L5–S1 junction, combined with altered load transfer after anterior and posterior reconstruction, may predispose to early sacral failure.

pmc-13080096.title: Neuro-immune-vascular-stem cell crosstalk in bone/cartilage regeneration: mechanisms, technological advances, and clinical perspectives
pmc-13080096.creator: Zhichao Liu, Haiyan Fan, Yun Yang
pmc-13080096.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Functional regeneration of bone and cartilage remains an urgent clinical challenge in orthopedics, as its repair process involves the synergistic participation of multiple systems and cell types. Traditional studies have mostly focused on the regulatory roles of individual cells or signaling pathways, while recent research has confirmed that bone/cartilage regeneration is governed by a regulatory mechanism centered on the neuro-immune-vascular axis.

pmc-13090585.title: Serologic response to VDRL in infants with congenital syphilis: ceftriaxone vs. penicillin
pmc-13090585.creator: Ana Nery Melo Cavalcante, Maria Alix Leite Araújo, Beatriz Sobreira Camilo Soares, Marina Arrais Nobre, Rosa Lívia Freitas de Almeida
pmc-13090585.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivePenicillin remains the only safe and effective drug recommended for treating syphilis in pregnant women and congenital syphilis (CS). Nevertheless, alternative therapies are needed when penicillin is contraindicated, such as in allergic reactions, or unavailable due to supply limitations. This study aimed to compare the serological response to the Venereal Disease Research Laboratory (VDRL) test in infants reported with CS and treated with either ceftriaxone or penicillin.MethodA non-competitive cohort study was conducted in three public maternity hospitals in Fortaleza, Ceará, Northeast Brazil.

pmc-13155329.title: Tough and Rapidly Relaxing Hydrogels Via Programmable Crosslink Kinetics
pmc-13155329.creator: Yuanyuan Wei, Stephen J.K. O'Neill, Jade A. McCune, Oren A. Scherman
pmc-13155329.description: Replicating the synergy of high toughness and rapid stress relaxation found in native tissues remains a central challenge for synthetic hydrogels on account of their intrinsic mechanical–temporal trade‐off. Here we introduce a supramolecular hydrogel platform that leverages kinetic programming to precisely regulate crosslink dynamics through molecular dissociation kinetics.

pmc-13265550.title: Density of tobacco retail outlets around school in Lao People's Democratic Republic 2024: a geospatial analysis
pmc-13265550.creator: Shweta Kulkarni, Thanh Cong Bui, Phonepadith Xangsayarath, Khatthanaphone Phangdouangsy, Chanthavy Soulaphy, Khanittha Sengdara, Sydney Martinez, Amanda Janitz, Summer G. Frank-Pearce, Laura A. Beebe
pmc-13265550.description: IntroductionExposure to tobacco advertising at tobacco retail outlets (TROs) is associated with smoking initiation among youth. There is limited geospatial evidence on the density of TROs in Lao People's Democratic Republic (PDR), a country with high prevalence of tobacco smoking.
